2645-3147-3181-3430.easyPrerequisites: Krosan Restorer doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3147-3181-3430.description:
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Krosan Restorer by tapping it, untapping Azorius Chancery
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Krosan Restorer.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

413-5929-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
413-5929-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Haru trigger, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, causing a player to mill three cards.
Repeat from step 5.

2757-4222-8039.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Spireside Infiltrator
Spireside Infiltrator triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping a basic Island.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Spireside Infiltrator.
Repeat.

2921-5170-6132-7574.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Sultai Flayer triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sultai Flayer trigger.
Resolve the Sultai Flayer trigger, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2021-2060-2313-3129.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

2811-4399-4518-6626.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Elas il-Kor trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elas il-Kor trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
2811-4399-4518-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

1619-3967-4605-5542-6144.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-3967-4605-5542-6144.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Goliath Paladin from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Goliath Paladin enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Goliath Paladin.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Goliath Paladin that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Goliath Paladin token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Goliath Paladin token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Goliath Paladin that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Goliath Paladin trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-3967-4605-5542-6144.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1303-2511-3249-5173.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Shambling Ghast enters, Necroduality triggers, creating a token copy of Shambling Ghast.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing both Shambling Ghasts.
When the Shambling Ghasts die, they triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

3081-3817-5256-7772.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Valiant Changeling.
When Valiant Changeling dies, Orah triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Valiant Changeling from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 7 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Orah triggers, allowing you to return a Cleric with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4359-7354.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4359-7354.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Endless Foot Assault as attackers.
Endless Foot Assault triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1251-3094-4659-5390-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
1251-3094-4659-5390-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {2} due to Forensic Gadgeteer and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

656-5220-7256.description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy with kicker by paying {2}{B}{R}.
Cast Ugin's Conjurant by paying {0}.
Ugin's Conjurant enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Warhost's Frenzy.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Ugin's Conjurant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Warhost's Frenzy trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Ugin's Conjurant from your library.
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1115-3259-4373.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-3259-4373.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ghalta and Mavren as attackers.
Ghalta and Mavren triggers, creating two creature tokens
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3263-7277.description: Cast Broadcast Takeover by paying {2}{R}{R}{R}, causing you to gain control of all permanents opponents control until end of turn (as they're all artifacts due to Mycosynth Lattice), untap them and give them haste.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

1322-3259-7208.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1322-3259-7208.description:
Declare Pestered Wellguard and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers. Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Faerie token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi

3750-7066.description:
Activate Avatar Kyoshi by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

1417-3705-5231-6896.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Bridge from Below triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Repeat.

339-677-1849-5256.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

560-1818-2034-4593.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers twice, causing you to gain 4 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
560-1818-2034-4593.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

uses.battlefieldCardState: is a creature without summoning sickness

478-539-6410--111.notablePrerequisites: You have max speed. You control at least three Goblins.
478-539-6410--111.description:
Activate Howlsquad Heavy by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Howlsquad Heavy.
Repeat.

1525-4030-5751-6504.description:
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting a land from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library and causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Cast Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land.
Repeat.

618-2292-3742.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Phantom Steed.
When the Phantom Steed token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Phantom Steed token.
When the Phantom Steed token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1170-3363-4030-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking The One Ring.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat.

784-1810-3327-3719.notablePrerequisites:
Dargo and Silas Renn are your commanders.
You have sacrificed a number of artifacts and/or creatures this turn equal to the number of times you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game minus four.
784-1810-3327-3719.description:
Cast Ruthless Technomancer by paying {3}{B}.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Dargo and create seven Treasure artifact tokens.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}{R}.
Cast Cackling Counterpart by paying {1}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When the Ruthless Technomancer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Ruthless Technomancer and create two Treasure artifact tokens.
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}{R}.
Activate the Ruthless Technomancer token by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing two Treasures, returning the nontoken Ruthless Technomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the nontoken Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Dargo and create seven Treasure artifact tokens.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Cast Dargo by paying {R} and sacrificing Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 8.

3375-4311-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

618-803-3320.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Goatnapper with haste.
The Goatnapper token enters the battlefield, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
